description: The REGR_* linear-regression aggregate family, argument order REGR_xxx(y, x) with y dependent and x independent. The base fixture is the perfect line y = 2x + 1 over x = 1..4, so the fit is exact and every statistic is a clean constant; NULL-bearing pairs are dropped entirely. The degenerate cases exercise the edges: a constant x gives a NULL slope and NULL R2 with SXX zero, a constant y gives R2 one, and an empty input counts zero while the rest answer NULL. Grouped regression fits each group separately. Converted 1:1 from functions/RegrFunctionsTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test and the 1e-9 tolerances are supplied by the testkit's numeric normalisation.
